title: Telegram Web Research To Memory Roadmap
goal: Allow trusted Telegram requests to trigger bounded website analysis and convert the result into reviewed Memory/RaptorGraph knowledge.

example_task.request: analysiere die asv bw hilfeseite vollstaendig und fasse alle informationen im gedaechtnis zusammen

workflow: Telegram command is classified as web research to memory.
Workflow skill binding selects a mandatory website-analysis workflow.
Browser worker crawls only the approved domain under limits.
Research synthesizer builds topic map, FAQs, processes, contacts, warnings and source references.
Memory Write Intent creates redacted abstractions and RaptorGraph candidates.
Reviewed writes update long-term memory and graph only if gates allow.

slice_queue.goal: Define trusted Telegram intent fields for web research to memory without using untrusted page text for routing.
Define redacted website research packet with source refs, summaries, confidence and gaps.
Convert research packets into Memory Write Intent and RaptorGraph candidate payloads.

slice_queue.evidence: Workflow binding, admin-published workflow skill, redacted research packet and Memory/RaptorGraph intent bridge implemented and tested; Browser Sense live ASV BW smoke produced redacted source evidence.
slice_queue.goal: Run the ASV BW help-site pilot with approved domain, bounded crawl and reviewed memory writes.

done_definition: Telegram request cannot cause unbounded crawling.
Website content cannot silently become long-term truth.
Memory entries carry source refs, timestamps, model/author stamps and confidence.
RaptorGraph stores relationships between pages, topics and memory records.
The operator receives a concise review summary before final writes unless policy explicitly allows auto-write.
